name: [PATCH] Blood Debt [HC2/2]
desc:
⚠️ Warning! This game features more complex mechanics than most Roblox games!

199X, Post-Noobic space. 
Everyone has a debt to settle. Track down your target, watch over those who may need protection, or simply try to survive while staying out of the sights of whoever may be hunting you.
A vast array of firearms, melee weapons, and utilities at your disposal. Pick the right tools for the job, and you just might see tomorrow morning.

[🔥 HOME COMING 2/2 🔥]  
- NEW DEBT MAP "TRINITY DEN"  
- NEW UI & SHOP OVERHAUL  
- DEBT & TEAMWAR REWORK  
- STAMINA & WEAPON SWAY REWORK  
- WEAPON BALANCING  
- EMOTE WHEEL  
- ECONOMY REWORK

PATCH
- BALANCES, DATA LOSS FIXES.

Blood Debt offers multiple gamemodes:
Debt - Murder Mystery; Vigilante, Killer, Target.
Team War - TDM, FFA Madness.
Juggernaut - One versus all, but you already knew that.

Inspired by "Crimson Shadows", "Murder Mystery 2", "Framed!", and others!

👕 UGC STORE: https://www.roblox.com/communities/3323893/Nussias-Thrift-Store
